curriculum.subject: LANGUAGE_ARTS
curriculum.description: Students blend sounds into complex words by combining initial and final consonant clusters in various word structures. Focus: Reading words with common initial and final consonant blends like bl, st, mp, and nd. Examples: blue, stop, lamp, sand, blow, star, jump, wind, black, fast. Constraints: Use visual cues to identify the blend segment separately from the vowel-consonant core in the phonics-blender.

status: authored; catalog-checked; each binding generator-probed once; not hydrated as a lesson; not runtime-tested
learnerAction: Read words with initial and final consonant blends, hearing each consonant in the cluster.

components.title: Warm Up With Short Words
components.intent: Grade 2 CVC review words that become blend words when one consonant is added (lap > clap, sad > sand).

components.title: Blend the Clusters
components.intent: Grade 2 words with initial blends (bl, st, cl, fr) and final blends (mp, nd, st): blue, stop, lamp, sand, jump, fast. No silent-e words.

evidenceCriteria: Says each blend word aloud from its tiles, judged against the target.
coverageLimits: As built, cvce_blend can never serve a blend: the generator pins the pattern to allowedTypes[0] = cvce (gemini-phonics-blender.ts:318). The probe got cake, bike, bone, cute, nine.
There are no final-blend examples in the prompt, and the UI never groups the blend apart from the vowel-consonant core.

recommendation.rationale: Fork the mode: split cvce_blend into cvce and blend (initial + final), the contract-first route for a mode that cannot serve half its name. Route to /eval-fix (PHB-1).
